meta.title: PLEASE HOLD
meta.description: Complete visual novel dialogue, including reactions for all eight minigames and the main narrative.
meta.delivery: Natural and slightly sarcastic at first, becoming suspicious, frightened and confrontational as the story unfolds. Pause briefly at ellipses.
meta.ordering: Story dialogue must play in the listed order. Do not randomly select or skip story-critical lines.

speakers.ENGINEER: The player character, speaking aloud or thinking to themselves.
speakers.SUPERVISOR: The engineer's supervisor, communicating through the bunker intercom.
speakers.COLLEAGUE_RECORDING: An archived recording left by a missing engineer.

dialogue_flow: After success, play the reaction matching the completed game ID, G1 through G8.
Play the story dialogue for the current narrative stage, C1 through C4.
Show the PIN digit awarded by the controller.
Transition to the next bunker background.
important_rules: Minigames can appear in a randomized order.
The first minigame must use one button.
Each game has its own unique completion reaction.
Story revelations depend on completion order, not minigame identity.
Only four of the eight regular minigames are played during one run.
Do not hard-code PIN digits into dialogue.
Dialogue should not interrupt active minigames.
Tunnel dialogue should trigger at specific gameplay moments.

G1.name: Signal Relay
G1.description: The player guides a signal pulse through obstacles.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Signal's through. Finally.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Since when does repairing a phone involve dodging obstacles?

G2.name: Lane Crossing
G2.description: The player crosses moving hazard lanes.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Made it across. That was closer than I'd like.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Whoever designed this diagnostic needs a new job.

G3.name: Core Defrag
G3.description: The player rotates and stacks falling blocks to clear rows.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Memory cleared. That's one less problem.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Did I seriously just play Tetris to repair a communication line?

G4.name: Rhythm Game
G4.description: The player keeps the rhythm after the drum track disappears.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: The drums stopped, but I kept the beat.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Never thought keeping rhythm would be part of this job.

G5.name: Circuit Sync
G5.description: The player times red and blue connections on a spinning circuit.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Red, blue… There. Everything's connected.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: At least that one almost felt like engineering.

G6.name: Pressure Valves
G6.description: The player keeps two pressure tanks stable by venting them.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Both tanks stabilised. Good.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: I really didn't want to find out what happens when those gauges hit red.

G7.name: Signal Lock
G7.description: The player locks a moving needle onto five target zones.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Five locks. Signal secured.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: That needle wasn't making it easy.

G8.name: Shelf Shuffle
G8.description: The player sorts four types of objects between two shelves, matching three identical objects at a time.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Everything sorted. Finally.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Why does a communications system need an inventory puzzle?

intro.description: Before C1. The engineer arrives at the bunker, the door locks unexpectedly, and the supervisor offers to help.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Underground bunker. Four dead lines. There goes my afternoon.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Hang on… Why's the door closing?

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: My card worked thirty seconds ago.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: Control here. Looks like a security fault triggered the lockdown. I'm working on the door from up here.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: In the meantime, restore those four communication lines. That should get the systems responding again.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Fine. You handle the door. I'll handle the phones.

c1_complete.description: After the first minigame. The first PIN digit is recovered. The engineer discovers that the lockdown was authorised before arriving.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: First line's back. What's this? A digit hidden in the diagnostics?

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: There's a lockdown record here. Let's see...

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Authorised at eight fourteen… I didn't get here until ten.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: Probably an old security entry. Don't worry about it. Just keep working on the lines.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: An old entry… Right.

c2_complete.description: After the second minigame. The second digit is recovered. The engineer discovers illegal surveillance records and recognises the routing from an earlier maintenance report.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Another digit. And more recordings… What exactly is this system storing?

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Home numbers. Private conversations. None of these people knew.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Wait. I know this routing. This is what I flagged in my maintenance report.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: You said it was a malfunction. Why was there a lockdown order before I arrived?

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: It's a security precaution. You're looking at records you don't understand. Finish the repairs.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Right. A precaution.

c3_complete.description: After the third minigame. The third digit is recovered. A recording from a missing colleague reveals the trap and explains the four-digit escape code.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Third digit. There's a voice recording attached to this one.

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE_RECORDING
lines.text: If you're hearing this, Control sent you down here too. Same four broken lines. Same locked door.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: I remember that voice. They said he'd transferred.

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE_RECORDING
lines.text: They need an authorised engineer to bring the archive back online. Once it's restored, they can erase the evidence.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: That's why they sent me.

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE_RECORDING
lines.text: I hid the exit code across all four systems. One digit in each. Get them all, and you can unlock the door.

lines.speaker: COLLEAGUE_RECORDING
lines.text: Don't trust Control. And whatever you do, don't leave the recordings behind.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Four systems. Four digits. He left a way out.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: I'm copying these recordings. All of them.

c4_complete.description: After the fourth minigame. The final digit is recovered. The engineer discovers the supervisor's sabotage, confronts him, and notices something watching from the vent.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: You've been quiet down there. Is the final line restored?

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Just working through the faults. Like you asked.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Hold on. The fault records… They weren't accidents. Someone deliberately shut these systems down.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: There's your authorisation. The sabotage order and the lockdown. Both signed by Control.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: You broke the lines yourself. Then put my name on the callout.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: You were supposed to restore the archive. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: I've got the order. Your voice is on it. And I've copied everything.

lines.speaker: SUPERVISOR
lines.text: You have no idea what you're getting yourself into.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Hello? …Yeah. Thought so.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: That's the last digit. Time to leave.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Wait… Are those eyes in the vent?

pin_entry.description: The player approaches the bunker door and enters the four-digit combination using the vault-style lock.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: There it is. Just one more lock.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Four digits. Come on…

pin_wrong.description: Shown when the player enters an incorrect combination.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: No. Slow down. Check the fragments.

pin_success.description: The correct code unlocks the door. The bunker door opens, revealing the dark maintenance tunnel.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Come on… Yes. Yes!

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: A tunnel? Of course there's a tunnel.

tunnel.description: The engineer enters the maintenance tunnel and encounters a creature that reacts to the flashlight.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: He said this leads outside. Please let him be right.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Those eyes… It's looking at the light.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: Right. Light off. Stay quiet. Keep moving.

ending.description: After surviving the tunnel, the engineer reaches the surface. The sun rises over the hills and the game ends.

lines.speaker: ENGINEER
lines.text: I'm out. Now I need to get these recordings to someone.

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: You are out. Now make sure the truth gets out too.
